KeyPassages: Matthew 14:20; Matthew 16:9; Mark 6:43; Mark 8:19; Luke 9:17; John 6:13
BiblicalUsage: Kophinos is a basket, a small basket for carrying. Matthew 14:20 and Mark 6:43 and Luke 9:17 and John 6:13 all count twelve baskets full of fragments after the five thousand were fed, Mark 8:19 has Jesus asking how many baskets full they took up, and Matthew 16:9 repeats the question.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the twelve baskets are the signature of the miracle: one basket for each tribe, one for each apostle, and nothing lost. I hold that Jesus asking how many baskets they took up is a test of memory, because the disciples who counted the baskets should have remembered who filled them.
